mathematics.assertion_tested: Finite-shot public run estimates of output T-state infidelity agree statistically with 3*p^2/2-p^3 for a literal two-qubit majority-feedback injection circuit.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact Clifford+T query algebra; finite-precision physical-noise sampling and floating Monte Carlo summaries.
mathematics.conventions: All qubits start zero; H prepares plus. CNOT data to injection ancilla; three nondestructive Z reports each flip independently with probability p; majority controls S on data. Target is T|+>, no postselection.

bounds.curve_method: Ordinary Monte Carlo via public run only; no exact noise enumeration or independent statevector simulator.

non_claims: Finite statistical agreement does not prove correctness for all nonlinear circuits or controllers.
The theory is used only for comparison after simulation, never as a simulator output.

randomness.generator: Python random.Random driving native physical-noise and Born sampling
randomness.policy: Use seed + point index for the predeclared probability list; no seed selection based on agreement.
